title: Home Purchase Financing Returned-Payment Fee — Lookback Period for Counting Returns
content:
**Lookback rule for counting returns on a Home Purchase Financing loan**

The returns counted for a returned-payment fee are taken over a lookback period before the fee date set as follows:

- **Autopay cancelled, repeated returns.** Where autopay on the loan has been cancelled and two or more payments were returned in the 12 whole months before the fee date, returns are counted over the 24 whole months before the fee date.
- **Autopay in force, isolated return.** Where autopay is in force and the return being charged is the only return in the 6 whole months before the fee date, returns are counted over those 6 months.
- **Any other loan.** Otherwise returns are counted over the 12 whole months before the fee date.

Whether autopay is in force or has been cancelled is shown on the loan record; the returns are the payment returns recorded on the loan's transactions, by their dates.

### Cases (hypothetical loans)

| Autopay | Returns in the 12 whole months before the fee date | Returns in the 6 whole months before the fee date | Lookback |
|---|---|---|---|
| cancelled | 2 | — | 24 whole months |
| cancelled | 1 | — | 12 whole months |
| in force | — | 1, the return being charged | 6 whole months |
| in force | — | 2 | 12 whole months |

On the first row, a further return dated 20 whole months before the fee date is counted; on the second row it is not.
